messages:
sam: quick heads-up — matmul schedule regression: quantized weight loads spike p95 on warm startup for long-seq jobs. I have a hotpatch that tweaks tile sizes and heuristics. planning a short-window deploy tonight, need handoffs and rollback criteria.

gopal: thanks. can you paste the perf delta and which models are affected?

sam: affected: embedder-v2 and chat-mid. local repro: p95 went from ~80ms -> ~220ms on 2k seq after quant build. patch brings p95 back to ~95ms in my dev run.

liz: good to know. QA: can we run a quick regression suite vs the canary image? I can run a 30m soak on staging with 1k-4k sequences.

qa-jen: I can start the soak at 20:00 UTC. will focus on embedder traffic and the tail latencies + error spikes.

oncall-mike: please add monitoring alarms: alert if error_rate > 0.3% sustained for 5m OR p95 increase > 60% vs baseline for 10m. auto-rollback if persists after 2 mins of mitigation attempts.

sam: noted. proposed deploy plan: 1) canary 3% for 10m, 2) 10% for 15m, 3) ramp to 50% if stable, then standard ramp. manual hold at each step.

deploy-bot: command suggestion:
```
/deploy matcross-hotpatch v2026-03-20a --canary=3% --canary-duration=10m --regions=us,eu
```

sam: release-note blurb (short): "Matmul kernel: quantized tiling fix to reduce warm-start tail latency for long-sequence workloads. Affects embedder-v2 and chat-mid models; no model weight changes."

liz: add to notes: "Known risk: transient memory pressure on older driver nodes — fallback policy will pin to previous kernel variant on error."

qa-jen: test checklist: 1) warmup soak 30m on staging, 2) perf trace p50/p95/p99, 3) correctness smoke (embedding similarity delta < 1e-4), 4) KV cache interaction tests.

oncall-mike: rollback criteria for ops: immediate rollback if error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 > 400ms for 3m. If small blip, we wait for mitigation (drain + increase batch delay), then rollback if no improvement.

sam: I will attach the canary image tag here once built (matcross:v2026-03-20a-quantfix). building now, ETA ~30m.

gopal: FYI — ranger nodes with older kernel-driver set will be excluded from canary to avoid false positives.

deploy-bot: scheduled window available 22:00-23:30 UTC. draft plan saved to /releases/matcross-hotpatch-2026-03-20.

liz: i'll be on hand for the first two gates. qa-jen please report asap if anything odd. :eyes:

qa-jen: will post a short report channel thread with perf snapshots.

sam: thanks all — will post the built image tag and release note snippet when done.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. canary 3% for 10m, auto-rollover to next step requires manual ack. auto-rollback triggers configured: [error_rate>0.5%_3m, p99>400ms_3m].
